title: Strictification of a circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a circuit with $n>0$ input vertices. First prepend three gates, a NOT gate reading vertex $0$, an OR gate reading vertices $0$ and $n$, and an AND gate reading vertices $0$ and $n$; shift every original vertex index at least $n$ upward by $3$, applying the corresponding gate transformation to each original gate and shifting the output index as well. Then seal the resulting circuit by processing its dead vertices.
